Drivers Single Out Birmingham Road Over Traffic Frustration

2026-10-03 Birmingham Live TomTom Traffic Index, Birmingham, Hagley Road, traffic congestion, urban mobility, London Northwestern Railway, evening rush hour, UK, speed data
Read the source article

Quick summary

Birmingham Live reports that drivers surveyed by London Northwestern Railway repeatedly named Hagley Road as Birmingham's least favourite road, while the TomTom Traffic Index 2025 recorded an average evening rush-hour speed of just 13mph across the city, illustrating the scale of Birmingham's congestion problem.

Key takeaways

  • Hagley Road was repeatedly named as Birmingham's least favourite road in a survey by London Northwestern Railway
  • The TomTom Traffic Index 2025 recorded an average evening rush-hour speed of 13mph across Birmingham, though not specifically on Hagley Road
  • The article combines survey data on driver frustration with TomTom's quantitative traffic data to illustrate Birmingham's congestion challenges
  • Hagley Road West in Quinton is identified as a specific bottleneck in the city's road network
